title: Extensionality for shareable red-black maps via rbt_ext_eqI and shareable_value_option_inj
intent: Reduce the user-facing equality rm0 = rm1 of two share maps to the pointwise equality of their rbt_share_map_α abstraction, then close it with two lemmas — the injectivity of the shareable_value_option wrap and the quotient extensionality rbt_ext_eqI of the underlying red-black tree — so that every later equality of share maps is proved by intro!: rbt_share_map_eqI instead of unfolding the representation.

parent.name: rbt_share_map_eqI
parent.statement:
lemma rbt_share_map_eqI:
  assumes \<open>rbt_share_map_\<alpha> rm0 = rbt_share_map_\<alpha> rm1\<close>
  shows \<open>rm0 = rm1\<close>

children.name: rbt_ext_eqI
children.statement:
lemma rbt_ext_eqI:
  assumes \<open>rbt_ext_\<alpha> rm0 = rbt_ext_\<alpha> rm1\<close>
    shows \<open>rm0 = rm1\<close>
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: rm0 = rm1 of the rbt_ext quotient follows from pointwise equality of rbt_ext_α of the two trees

children.name: shareable_value_option_inj
children.statement:
lemma shareable_value_option_inj:
  assumes \<open>shareable_value_option a = shareable_value_option b\<close>
    shows \<open>a = b\<close>
children.closed_by: auto simp add: shareable_value_option_def split!: option.splits
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: a = b of the options follows from equality of their shareable_value_option images

applicability.goal_shape: An equality x = y on a record- or quotient-wrapped map-like type, decided by pointwise equality of an abstraction α :: T ⇒ 'k ⇒ 'v that is injective up to an extensionality principle for the underlying representation.
applicability.use_when: The abstraction has an extensionality or injectivity lemma (here rbt_ext_eqI plus shareable_value_option_inj); the equality of the representation is needed many times (here 13), so a once-proved principle pays off; clients should not unfold the representation.
applicability.avoid_when: The abstraction is not injective (two distinct structures can share it, making the principle false); the underlying type has no quotient or extensionality lemma; the equality is needed only once, where the lemma is overhead.

consequences: Creates two obligations that the abstraction be sound: injectivity of the value-option wrap (shareable_value_option_inj) and extensionality of the underlying red-black-tree quotient (rbt_ext_eqI, itself resting on the rbt_ext_eq quotient). Once proved, every client equality closes by intro!: rbt_share_map_eqI plus ext and the abstraction's simp lemmas, without unfolding RmShareMap or rbt_ext. Failure modes: the principle gives the forward direction only (rbt_share_map_eqE, the reverse, is a separate lemma); it applies only to equalities already shaped as rbt_share_map_α x = rbt_share_map_α y, so a goal not of that form must unfold the representation instead.
